beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The calculation can be correct while the frame is too small.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Outfinitism begins with that uncomfortable possibility, rather than a rejection of reason.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A hospital shortens measured waiting times while difficult patients receive less attention.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its dashboard improves, yet the purpose behind the measurement starts to disappear.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This book asks how successful models acquire authority beyond what they justify.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It connects philosophical judgment with scientific representation, institutions, and artificial intelligence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Reading it means learning to inspect the boundary around an apparently good answer.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The question is what that answer leaves out, and who carries the cost.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A frame selects the domain, purpose, scale, and horizon of a decision.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It determines which differences matter and which differences the calculation ignores.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An engagement measure can count attention without deciding whether that attention helps anyone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A productivity score can reward visible activity while missing work worth doing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These are examples of narrowed judgment, not evidence that measurement is inherently worthless.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The author asks us to make the selection itself available for criticism.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You gain a vocabulary for questioning assumptions without abandoning useful technical knowledge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That distinction anchors the book before its more unfamiliar terminology arrives.
